#
# The operative directives are kept compact, standards-oriented, and readable.
# The large documentation layer below is comments only and therefore does not
# alter crawler behavior.
#
# Core policy:
#   - Public site content remains crawlable.
#   - /auth/ and /profile/ remain outside the crawl surface.
#   - Public CSS, JS, images, and pages remain crawlable.
#   - Sitemap is explicitly declared.
#   - No unsupported Crawl-delay or Noindex directive is used.
#
# IMPORTANT:
#   robots.txt controls crawling; it is not a guaranteed indexing mechanism.
#   Use a supported noindex mechanism when a URL must not be indexed.
# ============================================================================
